intro: This source-backed comparison evaluates Dell PowerEdge T350 and HPE ProLiant MicroServer Gen10 Plus v2 for a small creative agency planning a three-year deployment. It focuses on stable technical characteristics, deployment fit, interfaces, form factor, and operational trade-offs. It does not copy volatile prices, stock, star ratings, or unverified user claims.
verdict: Choose Dell PowerEdge T350 when small organizations needing a serviceable tower server is the leading requirement. Choose HPE ProLiant MicroServer Gen10 Plus v2 when small offices and edge sites needing a compact serviceable server matters more. For a small creative agency planning a three-year deployment, verify compatibility, support, current availability, and workload limits in the cited manufacturer documentation before purchase. The renewed M920q is the value reference at an estimated USD 240; the live listing determines the exact configuration and final price.
